title: Synchronized Teaching Timeline and Multi-Projection Playback
canonical_revision_note: Deliberately absent per D4 and D23. A test asserts no presentation contract declares canonical_revision_id. DO-013 owns revision provenance.

windows_local_results.note: One failure: the cp1252 console-encoding artifact. The DO-008 digest test passes in this worktree only because the artifact happens to hold LF bytes on disk; a fresh clone with core.autocrlf=true and no .gitattributes would smudge it to CRLF and fail again. The underlying condition is unchanged and out of scope per D21.

wsl_linux_results.node_not_run_reason: Node is not installed in this WSL distribution and installing it needs apt, which would modify the developer host. The browser suite was run on Windows with the platform recorded; per D22 it is separately executed tranche evidence rather than a CI gate.
wsl_linux_results.pip_bootstrap_note: The distribution ships python3 without pip or ensurepip. pip was installed user-scope into ~/.local via get-pip.py --user, with no sudo and no system package changes.

github_actions_note: Authoritative repository gate: Ruff, strict mypy, pytest --cov on ubuntu-latest. Recorded after the evidence commit is pushed.

node_results.ci_note: verify.yml deliberately unmodified per D22; CI hardening is a later Dev Order.

browser_smoke.driver: headless Chromium via the agent's browser automation tooling
browser_smoke.diagnostic_seam: window.__masDiagnostics.teachingTimeline plus a document.body data- mirror
browser_smoke.diagnostic_seam_note: D20: local diagnostics only, no browser-to-Python telemetry API. The DOM mirror exists because a headless driver evaluates in an isolated world and cannot read page globals.

repetition_proof.reason_not_golden_lesson: half_steps_one_string declares target_repetitions = 2 in its own practice policy, so its loop stops after two passes by design. Demonstrating the >= 3 repetitions the test plan asks for needs a lesson whose policy declares no target; ascending_scale does. Changing the golden lesson's policy would be lesson-content authority, not presentation.

defects_found_and_fixed_by_running_it.defect: hard seeks re-issued against a media element that cannot seek
defects_found_and_fixed_by_running_it.evidence: bundled DO-011 clip reports seekable=[0,0] with buffered=[0,3] and readyState=4

defects_found_and_fixed_by_running_it.defect: the Sync toggle label rendered light-on-light and was invisible
defects_found_and_fixed_by_running_it.evidence: Canvas-based media panel inside an app that sets near-white text

do008_result.note: resources/mvp2/do008_bundle and src/master_all_strings/integrations are byte-identical to the DO-012 base. The DO-008 browser export under web/mvp1/do008 gained timeline_anchors, which is the projection export and carries no semantic content; its behavior_digest is unmoved.

do009_digest.verification_method: Diffed against the DO-012 base: resources/performance, src/master_all_strings/performance, and DO009_INTEGRATION_EVIDENCE.json are all byte-identical, so none of the digest's inputs changed. The performance suite that asserts digest stability also passes on both platforms.

windows_environment_exceptions.cause: msys2 Python cp1252 stdout cannot encode U+2192 in scripts/verify_mvp1_release_lineage.py
windows_environment_exceptions.reason_not_fixed: D21 and the non-goals forbid console encoding fixes inside DO-012.

windows_environment_exceptions.cause: core.autocrlf=true with no .gitattributes smudges the content-addressed artifact to CRLF on checkout
windows_environment_exceptions.reason_not_fixed: D21 and the non-goals forbid .gitattributes changes inside DO-012.
windows_environment_exceptions.current_worktree_note: This test currently passes on the development host because the artifact holds LF bytes on disk. A fresh clone would smudge it again; the condition is unchanged.

deferred_out_of_scope_work.note: Three changes were prepared during this tranche and deliberately removed from it because D21, D22, and the non-goals forbid them. They are recorded here so a later hygiene Dev Order can pick them up rather than rediscover them.

items.change: verify.yml gains a Node step running the browser suite
items.would_fix: the browser half of the cross-language vector contract going unenforced in CI

items.change: verify_mvp1_release_lineage.py prints ASCII arrows instead of U+2192

non_interference.media_import_note: One-way, because the sidecar carries MediaTimelineBindingV1. No cycle.
